Replace the running coop binary with the latest GitHub release

Usage: coop update [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --check              Only check for an available update — do not download or install
      --force              Reinstall even if the current binary is already up to date
      --version <VERSION>  Install a specific version (e.g. `v0.3.2` or `0.3.2`)
  -y, --yes                Skip the interactive confirmation prompt
  -h, --help               Print help
